enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in his own room, keeping the room quiet and dark.
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed with eyes closed. Pulls the blanket up to the chest. Turns onto the right side. Keeps both arms under the pillow. Breathes slowly. Turns onto the left side. Adjusts the pillow under the head. Extends legs. Pulls the blanket back over the shoulder. Keeps the bedroom light switched off. Keeps the bedroom fan running. Rolls onto the back. Stays motionless on the mattress. Turns onto the right side again. Keeps eyes closed until the alarm time.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth quickly before Member 1's shower slot starts.
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes and sits up on the bed. Swings legs off the mattress and stands. Walks to the bedroom door and opens it. Walks to the bathroom door and pushes it open. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Cups both hands under the water. Splashes water onto the face. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel and wipes the face. Picks up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth for about one minute. Rinses the mouth with water from the cup. Spits into the sink. Rinses the toothbrush and puts it back in the holder. Turns off the tap. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out and closes the bathroom door before Member 1's 06:45 slot.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing nursing lecture notes and checking lockdown news and university emails on phone while the bathroom and kitchen are occupied by Member 1 and Member 2.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks back into Bedroom 3. Closes the bedroom door. Sits down on the bed. Picks up the phone from the bedside table. Unlocks the phone with the thumb. Opens the browser and taps the news page. Scrolls through lockdown news headlines with the index finger. Taps the university email app. Opens the unread emails one by one. Reads the emails and replies to one short message. Puts the phone face down on the bed. Stands and walks to the desk. Picks up the nursing lecture notes from the desk. Sits back on the bed with the notes. Turns the pages of the notes and reads the sections on medication administration. Marks one line with a pencil. Closes the notes. Picks up the phone again. Checks the time on the phone. Puts the phone into the pocket. Stands up and opens the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast while having breakfast with Member 1 and Member 2, checking university emails on phone.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the cupboard and takes out a bowl and a spoon. Opens the refrigerator and takes out milk and bread. Places the bread into the toaster and presses the lever down. Pours milk into the bowl. Picks up the cereal box and pours cereal into the bowl. Waits for the toaster to pop. Takes the toast out and puts it on a plate. Sits down at the kitchen table with Member 1 and Member 2. Eats the cereal with the spoon. Bites the toast. Says 'Morning' to Member 1 and Member 2. Picks up the phone and opens the university email app. Scrolls through the new emails. Puts the phone down on the table. Finishes the cereal and the toast. Carries the bowl, plate and spoon to the sink and sets them down.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up desk lamp and computer for a day of remote study in the bedroom.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the kitchen to Bedroom 3. Closes the bedroom door. Walks to the desk and sits on the chair. Presses the desk lamp switch and turns the lamp on. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Waits for the screen to light up. Picks up the phone and turns on the mobile hotspot. Places the phone beside the laptop. Logs into the Monash online learning platform with the keyboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending online nursing lecture via computer.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on the chair at the desk facing the computer. Moves the mouse and clicks the lecture link. Joins the online nursing lecture. Puts on the earphones. Turns up the speaker volume on the laptop. Keeps the notebook open on the desk. Picks up the pen. Writes the lecture title in the notebook. Watches the slides on the screen. Writes notes on patient care points. Pauses typing and writes one question in the chat box. Presses enter to send the question. Continues writing notes on medication administration. Types two short comments into the chat. Scrolls back through the slides on the screen. Copies one slide heading into the notebook. Closes the notebook at the end of the lecture. Clicks the leave button to exit the meeting.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying nursing coursework and taking notes on medication administration and patient care.
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the nursing coursework folder on the computer. Clicks the medication administration PDF. Scrolls through the document with the mouse. Picks up the pen and writes notes in the notebook. Opens the university library page in a new browser tab. Types 'patient care' into the search bar and presses enter. Opens one article and reads it. Copies two sentences into the notebook. Stands up and walks to the door and back to stretch the legs. Sits down again. Opens the online quiz page and answers ten practice questions. Clicks submit. Reads the result on the screen. Opens a second PDF on clinical placement guidelines. Highlights three lines with the mouse. Writes a summary in the notebook. Picks up the phone and checks the time. Puts the phone down. Continues typing notes on the keyboard. Closes the PDF at the end of the block.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch, reheating food with microwave, eating lunch alongside Member 1 and Member 2.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk and walks out of Bedroom 3. Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator and takes out the lunch container. Closes the refrigerator door. Opens the microwave door and places the container inside. Closes the door and presses the start button. Waits next to the counter. Opens the cupboard and takes out a plate and chopsticks. When the microwave beeps, opens the door and takes the container out. Pours the food onto the plate. Carries the plate to the table. Sits down at the table with Member 1 and Member 2. Eats the lunch with the chopsticks. Says a few words to Member 1 about the morning lecture. Picks up the phone and checks messages. Puts the phone down. Finishes the food. Stands up and carries the plate to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes and wiping the kitchen counter after lunch.
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on the kitchen tap. Picks up the sponge and squeezes dish soap onto it. Washes the plate and the bowl under the running water. Rinses the chopsticks and the spoon. Places the dishes on the drying rack. Turns off the tap. Picks up the cloth and wipes the kitchen counter. Wipes the area around the microwave. Wrings the cloth out over the sink. Hangs the cloth on the hook. Pushes the chair back under the table. Walks out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining online nursing tutorial and participating in case discussion.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 3 and closes the door. Sits on the chair at the desk. Moves the mouse and clicks the tutorial link on the screen. Joins the online nursing tutorial. Puts the earphones in both ears. Turns on the microphone when called on. Says 'Yes, I can hear you' into the microphone. Opens the case study file on the screen. Scrolls through the patient case. Types a response into the group chat. Presses enter. Unmutes the microphone and answers a question about medication dosage. Mutes the microphone again. Writes three points in the notebook with the pen. Nods at the screen. Types a second comment in the chat box. Answers a follow-up question out loud. Notes down the tutor's feedback in the notebook. Clicks the leave button at the end of the tutorial. Takes the earphones out.

enriched_activities.activity: Completing written nursing assignment and reviewing clinical placement notes on computer.
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the assignment document on the computer. Clicks at the end of the last paragraph. Types a new paragraph on patient assessment. Opens the placement notes file in a second window. Reads the notes on the screen. Copies two sentences into the assignment. Types the reference at the end of the paragraph. Presses save with Ctrl+S. Opens the university referencing guide in a browser tab. Checks the citation format. Edits one reference line on the keyboard. Stands up and walks to the bedside table. Picks up the water bottle and drinks. Puts the bottle back. Sits down at the desk again. Types two more paragraphs. Saves the document again. Opens the placement notes file and scrolls to the last page. Writes one question in the notebook. Closes both files at the end of the block.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling kettle for tea and preparing a light afternoon snack while Member 2 cooks dinner nearby.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up and walks out of Bedroom 3 into the kitchen. Fills the kettle with water from the tap. Places the kettle on the base and presses the switch down. Opens the cupboard and takes out a cup and a tea bag. Drops the tea bag into the cup. Opens the refrigerator and takes out a packet of biscuits. Takes two biscuits out and puts the packet back. Stands to the side while Member 2 cooks at the induction cooker. Pours hot water from the kettle into the cup when it boils. Picks up the cup and the biscuits. Walks to the table and sits down. Eats the biscuits and drinks the tea. Says 'Smells good' to Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using induction cooker and rice cooker, sharing the kitchen with Member 1 who is also cooking dinner.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the table and carries the cup to the sink. Opens the refrigerator and takes out vegetables and chicken. Washes the vegetables under the tap. Places the vegetables on the cutting board. Picks up the knife and cuts the vegetables into pieces. Puts the chicken into a bowl with the spoon. Turns on the induction cooker and presses the heat setting button. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the vegetables to the pan and stirs with the spatula. Opens the rice cooker lid and adds rice and water with the measuring cup. Closes the lid and presses the cook button. Moves aside to let Member 1 use the counter. Adds the chicken to the pan and stirs again. Presses the heat button to lower the setting. Opens the cupboard and takes out two plates. Turns off the induction cooker. Spoons the food onto the plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with Member 1.
enriched_activities.desc: Carries both plates to the kitchen table. Sets one plate in front of Member 1 and one in front of his own chair. Opens the rice cooker lid and spoons rice onto both plates. Closes the lid. Sits down on the chair. Picks up the chopsticks. Eats the rice and the chicken and vegetables. Talks with Member 1 about the online tutorial. Picks up the phone and checks one message. Puts the phone face down on the table. Drinks water from the cup. Finishes the food on the plate. Stands up and carries the plate to the sink. Says 'I'll do the dishes' to Member 1. Sits back down and waits until Member 1 finishes eating.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up after the study day.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the kitchen to Bedroom 3. Opens the wardrobe and takes out a towel and clean clothes. Walks to the bathroom door and pushes it open. Turns on the bathroom light. Hangs the towel on the hook. Turns on the shower tap and adjusts the water temperature with the handle. Steps into the shower. Wets the hair and body under the water. Picks up the shampoo bottle and squeezes shampoo onto the hand. Rubs the shampoo into the hair. Rinses the hair under the water. Picks up the soap and rubs it over the arms and body. Rinses off the soap. Turns off the tap. Steps out of the shower. Picks up the towel and dries the hair and body. Puts on the clean clothes. Hangs the wet towel on the hook. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the door and walks out, leaving the bathroom free for Member 6's 19:30 laundry slot.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on online pharmacy assistant training modules and refreshing aged-care aide skills.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 3 and closes the door. Sits on the chair at the desk. Presses the desk lamp switch and turns the lamp on. Moves the mouse and clicks the pharmacy training module link. Logs in with the keyboard. Reads the module on dispensing procedures on the screen. Scrolls down through the module pages. Clicks the next button on each page. Answers the module quiz questions with the mouse. Clicks submit and reads the score on the screen. Moves the mouse to close the module window. Opens the aged-care aide skills video in a new browser tab. Watches the video on moving and handling techniques. Writes three points in the notebook with the pen. Pauses the video and rewrites one point. Plays the rest of the video. Closes the browser tab. Presses the desk lamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and tidying the kitchen counter.
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up and walks out of Bedroom 3 into the kitchen. Fills the kettle with water and presses the switch down. Opens the cupboard and takes out a cup and a tea bag. Drops the tea bag into the cup. Pours the hot water into the cup when the kettle switches off. Picks up the cup and walks to the table. Sits down and drinks the tea. Stands up and carries the cup to the sink. Washes the cup and places it on the drying rack. Picks up the cloth and wipes the kitchen counter. Wipes the area around the induction cooker. Wrings the cloth out and hangs it on the hook. Pushes the chairs under the table. Walks out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading nursing textbook and scrolling phone before bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 3 and closes the door. Sits on the bed. Picks up the nursing textbook from the bedside table. Opens the book at the marked page. Reads two pages on patient care. Turns the page with the right hand. Puts the book down on the bed. Picks up the phone from the bedside table. Unlocks the phone and scrolls through the news feed with the thumb. Taps one video and watches it. Scrolls further down the feed. Taps the messages app and reads two messages. Types a short reply and presses send. Puts the phone face down on the bedside table. Picks up the textbook again and reads one more page. Closes the book. Places the book on the bedside table. Stands up and walks to the door. Presses the light switch off.

Walks to the bed in the dark. Pulls back the blanket and lies down on the mattress. Pulls the blanket up to the chest. Places the head on the pillow. Turns onto the right side. Keeps the bedroom light switched off. Keeps the bedroom fan running. Adjusts the pillow with the left hand. Turns onto the back. Stretches both arms beside the body. Turns onto the left side. Pulls the blanket over the shoulder. Keeps eyes closed. Stays motionless on the bed. Turns onto the right side again. Remains asleep until the end of the night.
